lines.li: [us] Is it true about you and {WAR}?
[them,their:tribal] It is, the war drums sound again.
[them,their:medieval] It is, and the levies have been called.
[them,their:empire] It is, and the Empire will answer them.
[them] It is, and it's only just begun.
[us] I'm sorry, I hope it ends quickly.
[them,war:ourfoe] They're no friends of yours either, from what I hear.
[them] So do I, believe me.
[us] If there's word of how it goes, I'd like to hear it.
[them] We're still at odds with {WAR}, if you were wondering.
[us] Does it ever let up?
[them,their:tribal] Some moons are quiet, and some are not.
[them,their:medieval] It comes and goes with the seasons, like the tax collector.
[them] Now and then, and then it starts up again.
[us] That must wear on everyone.
[them] It does, but we're used to it now.

ColonyCouncil.OutsiderTalkDef.heard: {PEOPLE} have fewer towns than when their war with {WAR} began.

lines.li: [us] How goes it with {WAR}?
[them] Badly, we've fewer towns than when it started.
[us,town] I'm sorry, is {TOWN} safe?
[us] I'm sorry, is your home safe?
[them,their:tribal] For now, the spirits willing.
[them] For now, and we don't talk about later.
[us] If there's anything we can do, say so.
[them] I'll remember you said that.

ColonyCouncil.OutsiderTalkDef.heard: {WAR} have lost ground in their war with {PEOPLE}.

lines.li: [us] Any news of the fighting with {WAR}?
[them,their:tribal] They have one camp fewer than when it began, and we sing about it.
[them] Good news, for once, they've a town fewer than when it started.
[us] Then it may end soon.
[them] We'll see, they're stubborn.
[us] Then I hope they give in before it costs you more.
[them] I heard our people and {WAR} came to blows on your land.
[us] They did, it isn't something we'll forget.
[them] Then you've seen what we live with.
[us] A little of it, and that was enough.
[them] Then you understand us a little better now.
[them] You're on good terms with {WAR}, I hear.
[us] We try to be on good terms with everyone.
[them,their:tribal] A wise hunter keeps more than one path open, I suppose.
[them] Just don't sell them anything sharp.
[us] We'll keep that in mind.
[us] {WAR} are no friends of ours either.
[them,their:tribal] Then our spears point the same way.
[them] Then we have something in common.
[us] For what it's worth.
[them] We're at peace with {PEACEWITH} now, did you hear?
[us] I hadn't, that's good news.
[them,their:tribal] The spears are back on the wall, for now.
[them,their:medieval] The lords shook hands, and nobody trusts it yet.
[them,their:empire] Terms were agreed, and the court is satisfied.
[them] For now, and everyone's holding their breath.
[us] Let's hope it holds.
[them,their:tribal] The children can play by the river again.
[them] We'll see if it does.
[them] Have you heard {WARA} and {WARB} are at each other's throats?
[us] No, since when?
[them] Not long, and nobody knows how it'll go.
[us] As long as they keep it away from here.
[them] Let's hope so, but wars have a way of spreading.
[them] They say {BATTLEA} and {BATTLEB} fought right here on your land.
[us] They did, and we were glad when it was over.
[them] I'd have been, too.
[them] I hear some of ours fought on your land.
[us] They did, {BATTLEA} against {BATTLEB}.
[them] I hope ours gave a good account of themselves.
[us] I'll leave the counting to them.
[them] You'll hear soon enough, {SITUATION} has come to us.
[us] When did it start?
[them] Only days ago, and it's all anyone talks about.
[us,situation:bad] I'm sorry, I hope it passes quickly.
[us,!situation:bad] That's something, isn't it?
[them,situation:bad] So do we.
[them,!situation:bad] It is, and we mean to make the most of it.
[us] Is {SITUATION} still going on at home?
[them] Still, and it feels like it'll never end.
[us] How are people holding up?
[them,their:tribal] We share what we have and wait for better moons.
[them,their:medieval] Praying, grumbling, and getting on with it.
[them] Tired, short-tempered, and stubborn.
[us] Stubborn is good.
[them] It's what we've got.
[them] Keep your people close, {SITUATION} is about.
[us,town] Is it near {TOWN}?
[us] Is it near you?
[them,situation:theirs] It's among us, yes.
[them,!situation:theirs] Not yet, and we're hoping it stays away.
[us] We'll keep an eye on our own, then.
[them] Wise, sickness travels faster than anyone.

ColonyCouncil.OutsiderTalkDef.heard: {SITUATION} has the region counting its stores.

lines.li: [them] {SITUATION} has everyone counting their stores.
[us,colony:hungry] Ours are thin enough already.
[us,colony:plenty] We've enough put by, for now.
[us,!colony:hungry,!colony:plenty] We'll keep an eye on ours.
[them] Wise of you.
[them] Everyone on the road is talking about {SITUATION}.
[us] Is it bad where you are?
[them,home:frozen] We're used to it, but even we're stacking wood.
[them] Bad enough that I'd stock up on firewood, if I were you.

ColonyCouncil.OutsiderTalkDef.heard: {SITUATION} has travelers keeping together on the roads.

lines.li: [them] With {SITUATION}, nobody travels alone if they can help it.
[us] You came all the same.
[them,role:trader] Silver doesn't wait for peace.
[them] I did, and I kept my eyes open the whole way.

ColonyCouncil.OutsiderTalkDef.heard: {SITUATION} has trade moving in the region.

lines.li: [them] Have you heard about {SITUATION}?
[us] A little, what's the word?
[them,role:trader] Good for business, if you know where to stand.
[them] Everyone wants a piece of it, that's the word.

ColonyCouncil.OutsiderTalkDef.heard: {SITUATION} has made trade harder in the region.

lines.li: [them] {SITUATION} has made everything dearer.
[us] Everything?
[them,role:trader] Everything I buy, anyway, and nothing I sell.
[them] Everything worth having.
[them] Have you heard of {SITUATION}?
[us] Only a little.
[them,samefaith] It stirs the heart, if you keep the faith.
[them] People talk of little else on the road.
[us] Then I'll listen when they do.
[them] Good, it's worth hearing.
[them] What do your people make of {SITUATION}?
[us] We hear about it late, out here.
[them,their:tribal] Lucky, the arguing goes on long into the night.
[them] Count yourselves lucky, the arguing never stops.
[them] {SITUATION} has the court busier than I've ever seen it.
[us] Is that good or bad for you?
[them,their:noble] For one of my rank, it means more letters and less sleep.
[them] For me, it means more work.
[them] Have you seen anything of {SITUATION}?
[us] Not yet, should we be watching for them?
[them,their:tribal] Watch, and give thanks if they pass close.
[them] Watching never hurts.
[them] {SITUATION} has everyone shaken.
[us,situation:theirs] Did it reach {PEOPLE}?
[us] Is anyone you know caught up in it?
[them,situation:theirs] It did, and we're still picking up after it.
[them,!situation:theirs] Not that I know of, thank the stars.
[them] People at home know you helped us with {SITUATION}.
[us] We did what we could.
[them,their:tribal] The elders will speak your name at the fire.
[them] It was noticed, believe me.
[them] {ENDED} is over, at last.
[us] That's a relief, how did it end?
[them,ended:helped] Better than it might have, and your people had a part in that.
[them,!ended:helped] It just did, and nobody's complaining.
[us] Good, I'm glad.
[them] So are we, and we're still counting our blessings.
[us] Is everyone well at {TOWN} now?
[them] Better, {ENDED} has run its course.
[us] You must all be glad of it.
[them,their:tribal] The spirits have turned their faces back to us.
[them] Glad, and a little afraid it'll come back.
[us] Let's hope it stays gone.
[us] How are you getting on with {CONDITION}?
[them,their:tribal] The spirits are restless, and so are we.
[them] Same as you, I expect, and hoping it ends soon.
[us] It can't last forever.
[them] I kept a cloth over my face the whole way here.
[us] Wise, the fallout gets into everything.
[them] Stay indoors as much as you can.
[them] The sky's been gray so long I've forgotten its color.
[us] It's hard on everyone.
[them,their:tribal] The old songs say the sun comes back, so we keep singing.
[them] Harder on the fields than anyone.
[them] This cold came out of nowhere.
[us] It caught us out too.
[them] Mind your crops, if you've any left in the ground.
[them] I've never walked in heat like this.
[us] It'll break soon, it has to.
[them] I'll travel by night until it does.
